scenes.basis: 5:1 "he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret"; 5:2 "He saw two boats standing by the lake"
5:12 "While he was in one of the cities" - the city is not named; it follows the Galilee ministry (4:44)
5:17 "On one of those days, he was teaching" and 5:29 "Levi made a great feast for him in his house" - the city is not named in Luke; it is the Capernaum ministry begun at 4:31
